{{Quote|This is the Kolatill Council&hellip;all New Republic forces, please send assistance immediately. After imprisoning the Imperial governor we have been attacked by TIE bombers. Domaz, our capital, is in flames. Please send emergency medical assistance.|Distress call from Kolatill|<ref name="Omens" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Domaz]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]], was '''bombed''' by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] allied to the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. Sarne ordered the assault on the city after the population of Kolatill ousted [[Tetrum]], their Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]], and declared their allegiance to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], who had recently [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] the neighboring world of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]. [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], deployed from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Kathol Protector]]'', attacked the city, leveling buildings and leaving the city aflame. After the enemy force withdrew, the citizens of Domaz rallied to cope with the disaster and called for New Republic aid.

==Prelude==
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] overthrew their [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Tetrum]], when word reached them that a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]] had [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] the neighboring planet of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]].<ref name="Omens" /> Kal'Shebbol was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and the seat of power for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], who ruled the sector in the name of the Galactic Empire and, later, as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], following the fracturing of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Saga" /> Kolatill's citizenry re-established the [[Kolatill Council]]&mdash;which had been forcibly disbanded during Sarne's rule&mdash;and promptly declared their allegiance to the New Republic.<ref name="Omens" />

==The bombing==
Sarne, in retaliation for Kolatill's act of defiance, dispatched the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Kathol Protector]]'' to the [[Kolatill system/Legends|Kolatill system]]. The ''Kathol Protector'' approached Kolatill, releasing [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]; targeting the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Domaz]], the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] proceeded to assault the city with conventional explosive ordnance. The attack reduced many areas of the city to rubble and left large portions of the city in flames. The bombers eventually disengaged and regrouped with the ''Kathol Protector''. The escort carrier subsequently withdrew from the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Omens" />

==Aftermath==
With Domaz left in chaos, citizens of the city pulled together to deal with the disaster. Volunteer groups formed to deal with rescue operations; tending to the injured, creating temporary shelters, and fighting the many fires raging across the city. The Kolatill Council issued an emergency distress call to the New Republic forces stationed at Kal'Shebbol, requesting urgent assistance. The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''&mdash;which was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet preparing to undertake a mission to track down Sarne after he had fled from Kal'Shebbol during the New Republic's assault on the world&mdash;received the transmission. The [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keleman Ciro]], ordered the ''FarStar'' to Kolatill to assist in relief operations, while Governor [[Monjai]], the newly-appointed New Republic official on Kal'Shebbol, promised to send further assistance in a few days.<ref name="Omens" />

The ''FarStar'' arrived several days after the attack and assisted in relief operations in the city. While in orbit, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was forced to defend Kolatill from a [[Battle of Kolatill|second attack]] by the ''Kathol Protector'', which deployed TIE bombers armed with [[pathogenic bomb]]s. The New Republic force was able to successfully defend the planet, ensuring no further harm was inflicted upon its citizens.<ref name="Omens" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bombing of Domaz was first referenced in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Omens]]'', which was the first scenario for ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. The bombing was the reason that brought the players' ship, the ''FarStar'', to the planet Kolatill, so that the characters could assist in relief operations and defend the planet from the second Imperial attack.<ref name="Omens" />
